title: The Folded Distance Compendium
summary: A compendium that joins time to space so that the distance to a foe can be folded shut or stretched long while the moment inside it is slowed or hastened.

title: A Treatise on the Directed Moment
summary: A treatise that joins time to the pull of fate so that the nearest threads of what will happen can be read and guided and one blow can be set on its mark.
